title: NPE in HttpConnector.java

labels.name: P2
labels.description: We'll consider working on this in future. (Assignee optional)

body:
Please provide the following information. The more we know about your system and use case, the more easily and likely we can help.

### Description of the problem / feature request / question:

Bazel's HttpConnector.java hits an NPE trying to read the nonexistent message out of an exception thrown by an attempted HTTP connection. This was not an issue before upgrading to 0.4.3

### Environment info
* Operating System: Ubuntu 14.04


* Bazel version (output of `bazel info release`): 0.4.3, but the problem is still there at HEAD

###  Have you found anything relevant by searching the web? (e.g. GitHub issues, email threads in the [bazel-discuss@googlegroups.com](https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/bazel-discuss) archive)
No

### Anything else, information or logs or outputs that would be helpful?
(If they are large, please upload as attachment or provide link).
